test_failure_loop.rationale: Tests failing repeatedly require QA investigation and flaky test fixes.

excessive_retries.rationale: Agent instability or brittle integrations — needs AI model/automation engineering.

high_token_consumption.rationale: High token usage impacts cost; FinOps should optimize model choices and pricing.

high_latency.rationale: Platform performance issues; investigate infra or network bottlenecks.

human_intervention.rationale: Human-in-the-loop suggests feature or workflow gaps for the owning repo team.

insufficient_evidence.rationale: Data collection or telemetry gaps — platform should improve observability.

low_overall_performance.rationale: Overall poor performance likely requires model or pipeline improvements.

unknown_underperformance.rationale: Investigate telemetry and logs to determine root cause.
